lowTier.pickpocketDesespere: A kid with a rusty knife.
lowTier.gardeCorrompu: He forgot who he works for.
lowTier.milicienDePacotille: Badly trained, badly equipped, dangerous anyway.
lowTier.chasseurDePrimesNovice: Apparently your head is worth something.
lowTier.gaminDeLaZone: Twelve years old and a chunk of metal. Dangerous.
lowTier.ouvrierEnColere: He wasn't paid. You're the one who'll pay for it.
lowTier.mendiantArme: He found a knife in a trash pile.
lowTier.piloteRate: His ship is wrecked. He blames you for it.
lowTier.toxicomaneSousInjection: Unpredictable. The drugs give him strength.
lowTier.ratDeCargaison: He's been living in your holds for weeks.
lowTier.fuyardePaniquee: She's fleeing something worse than you.
lowTier.reparateurJaloux: You bought his rare part. He wants it back.
lowTier.drogueAuSynth: Synth cuts the pain. And the sense.
lowTier.eclaireurFaucon: Black Falcons recruit. Fast, unreliable, zealous.
lowTier.recrueGardienne: First Guardian patrol. She's on edge.
lowTier.vigileEmporium: Underpaid Emporium watchman. Aggressive out of frustration.
lowTier.survivantDesRuines: Nothing's left of the station. Just him.
lowTier.deserteurEnErrance: He abandoned his faction. Now he fights to eat.
lowTier.junkieAuxImplants: Cheap, badly integrated implants. He's in pain, and it makes him unpredictable.
lowTier.messagerIntercepte: He was carrying something. He defends his mission to the end.
lowTier.recuperateurDeDettes: Someone sent him to collect what you owe. Or what he thinks you owe.
lowTier.contrebandierJunior: First delivery, first problem. Him and you both.
lowTier.gardeFrontiereVereux: He controls a checkpoint. He taxes everything that passes.
lowTier.piloteSaborde: His ship went down. He lost everything. He wants something back.
lowTier.enfantSoldatRecycle: He was ten when the war started. Ten years of training since.
lowTier.gardePenitentiaireRogue: The prisons are closing. The guards stay armed.
lowTier.chasseurDeTeteLocal: He works his own patch. Efficient on home turf.
lowTier.soldatDeFactionBlesse: Wounded in battle, not wounded enough to stop.

midTier.chasseurDePrimes: He's got your head on his list.
midTier.deserteurArme: He betrayed his faction. Nothing left to lose.
midTier.trafiquantDOrganes: He's interested in what's inside you.
midTier.sergentDesBasFonds: He runs his neighborhood with his fists.
midTier.hackerDeRue: He sabotaged your gear before you noticed.
midTier.dresseurDeBetesMutantes: His creature bites. So does he.
midTier.caidDeStation: He taxes everyone on this station. You too, now.
midTier.agentDouble: He works for three factions. None of them know it yet.
midTier.gladiateurSansContrat: He fights to survive. No arena wants him anymore.
midTier.agentFauconInfiltre: Black Falcons operative undercover. He has orders.
midTier.gardeEmporiumArme: High-end security. Paid to kill cleanly.
midTier.scavengerVeteran: Years spent in the wrecks. He knows the blind spots.
midTier.mercenaireDesRuines: He squats in dead stations. Not for the philosophy.
midTier.chasseurDeReliques: He's interested in the ruins. And in you too.
midTier.veteranDeLaPurge: He survived a purge. He has no morals left to lose.
midTier.technomercenaire: He sabotages you before he even draws. His gadgets do the heavy lifting.
midTier.receleurDefensif: His stock is worth more than his life. He's perfectly aware of it.
midTier.soldatDeFortuneFaucon: Not an official Falcon. Equipped and paid like one.
midTier.ingenieurDeSabotage: He neutralizes you before the fight starts. The gadgets do the heavy lifting.
midTier.trafiquantEnReseau: His connections make him more dangerous than his gear.
midTier.espionRetourne: He's switched sides too many times. He no longer knows who he really is.
midTier.commandantDeMilice: He's ruled his turf for ten years. He has no plans to change that.
midTier.chasseurMutant: He stopped being human in stages. The hunting instinct survived.
midTier.artilleurDeSection: He used to have a squad. Now he just has his gun.

highTier.gardeDeLEmporium: Heavy armor, zero sense of humor.
highTier.medecinDeGuerreEnnemi: He heals his allies and wrecks you.
highTier.chasseurDeTrophees: Your head will decorate his cockpit.
highTier.ingenieurDeGuerre: His gadgets hit as hard as his fists.
highTier.commandantRenegat: He's led battles. He knows the weaknesses.
highTier.fantomeDeLaGardeNoire: Disbanded elite unit. They never turned in their weapons.
highTier.berserkerAugmente: Illegal military implants. He can no longer feel pain.
highTier.executeurDuTribunal: A death sentence was passed on you. He carries it out.
highTier.piloteDeCombatAuSol: His ship is destroyed. He blames you for it.
highTier.sniperDesAbysses: One kilometer minimum distance. Today it's a lot closer.
highTier.gardeDHonneurBrise: His lord is dead. He's looking for someone to kill over it.
highTier.ancienDuVide: Years in the void changed him. Not for the better.
highTier.traqueurDeFactions: His faction sent him. He only comes back with your head.
highTier.commandantFauconNoir: Falcon officer. Every order he's given has cost lives.
highTier.capitaineGardienEcarlate: Garrison commander. She's held fortresses alone.
highTier.executeurDeLEmporium: He solves the Emporium's problems. You're a problem.
highTier.baronDesBasFonds: He controls an entire district. No way he's letting you through.
highTier.veteranDesRuines: Decades in dead stations. He's seen it all, survived it all.
highTier.thanatonaute: He's emptied himself out. Combat is the only thing left of him.
highTier.fanatiqueDeLaFracture: He believes the Great War never ended. He's right, in a way.
highTier.gardeAugmenteDuNexus: Nexus-grade implants, fully integrated. He doesn't need sleep.
highTier.lameFantome: You only see him once. Usually it's too late by then.
highTier.artificierDerange: He builds his own weapons and tests them on people he meets.
highTier.generalDeLaDerniereGuerre: He's still fighting the same war. For him it never ended.
highTier.bioingenieurDeCombat: He modified himself for combat. Every modification has a precise purpose.
highTier.chevalierEcarlateRenegat: He wore the red and defended it. Then he saw something that changed everything.
highTier.infiltrateurDeHautRang: Three identities. None of them real. Combat is the only real thing left for him.
highTier.executeurDeLaPurge: The Purge is officially over. He kept going anyway.
highTier.piloteNexusAuSol: His ship is destroyed, his navigation implants still active.

bossTier.alanossa: The most dangerous pirate in the known universe.
bossTier.laFaucon: Leader of the Black Falcons. Calculating. Relentless.
bossTier.leBoucherDeVelkor: They say he destroyed an entire station. Alone.
bossTier.oracleDeLaSingularite: He predicts your moves. He's already seen them.
bossTier.amiralVossKheran: Commander of the Shadow Fleet. Uncompromising.
bossTier.laCuratrice: She collects souls. Yours interests her.
bossTier.frereOssianLeDernier: Last survivor of an order of warrior-monks.
bossTier.laMereMecanique: Half human, half machine. Her children adore her.
bossTier.veilleurDuBoutDuMonde: He's guarding something. You shouldn't have gotten close.
bossTier.lArchitecteDuChaos: Every war of the last hundred years — that was him.
bossTier.commandanteZaraSable: She lost her fleet. She gained an obsession.
bossTier.leColosseDeFerraille: A man in seven feet of scrap-metal armor.
bossTier.leFantomeDesOmbres: Falcon operative. You never see him coming. That's the job.
bossTier.laBeteNoire: Falcon berserker. No reason left. Only brutality.
bossTier.laVeuveDeVega: Pirate queen of the underworld. She's survived everything. Including you.
bossTier.lExileEcarlate: Banished Guardian. He turned his faith against his former brothers.
bossTier.patientZero: Quarantine survivor. What he lived through transformed him.
bossTier.lOmbreDuVide: Nobody knows who he is. He prefers it that way.
bossTier.leRoiDeNuit: He rules Night Port from the shadows. He never leaves it.
bossTier.leFerrailleurDesEpaves: King of the Wreckyard. He grew up in the wrecks. He became one.
bossTier.lInspecteurVereux: Head of security at Meridian Port. The laws bend however he wants.
bossTier.leBaronDeVega: Underworld lord. Everything sold in the Underbelly belongs to him.
bossTier.leGeneralDeFer: Commander of Fort Kharos. Iron discipline. No exceptions.
bossTier.protocoleX7: Nexus Aldara's security AI. It decided humanity was the threat.
bossTier.leGeolierDesMorts: Former warden of Purgatory. He never left. Neither did his methods.
bossTier.laMatriarcheDePersephone: She fed the colony for thirty years. Now she defends it with weapons.
bossTier.leTitanMineur: Foreman of Rocaille Station. Augmented to carry tons. He carries the blows too.
bossTier.leMaitreForgeronMaudit: Artisan of the Black Forge. Every weapon he makes, he tests the quality on someone.
bossTier.lArchivisteSansVisage: Keeper of Warehouse Zero. He knows every secret. He buries the rest.
bossTier.leVigieImmortel: Falcon operative at the Perch. He's been watching so long he can't do anything else.
bossTier.leRavitailleurDeLOmbre: Falcon logistics chief at the Black Relay. Without him the faction collapses. He knows it.
bossTier.commandantGarant: Commander of Minor Bastion. He is the Guardian frontier.
bossTier.laMarchandeDeMort: Trader at South Counter. What she sells always kills, even the insurance contracts.
bossTier.leDirecteurFantome: Head of the Commercial Annex. Officially a bureaucrat. Unofficially, a ghost.
bossTier.lePasseurSanguinaire: He controls Transit Relay. Everything that passes through, he taxes. Or takes.
bossTier.lordDaekar: Fallen noble of the Orbital Residence. He lost everything. Except his violence.
bossTier.leMaitreDesOmbres: Organizer of the Private Club Eos. The secrets he holds are worth armies.
bossTier.leSurvivantDesCendres: Sole inhabitant of the Ashes. What kept him alive also transformed him.
bossTier.leGardienOriginel: Guardian of the Cradle since its founding. He'll let no one desecrate this place.
bossTier.leCapitaineAmalgame: Captain of the Living Wreck. Half man, half machine. He fused with his ship.
bossTier.leMediateurDeFer: Arbiter of the Iron Oasis. He keeps the peace. With less than peaceful methods.
bossTier.leGardienDuSignal: Operator of the Beacon. He controls the shipping lanes. He abuses it.
bossTier.leSeigneurDesRoutes: Toll-keeper of the Confluence. Every crossroad belongs to him. Especially this one.
bossTier.leChercheurFracture: Former Zephyr scientist. His experiment went wrong. So did his mind.
bossTier.lAstronomeDesAbysses: Observer at the Observatory. Too long alone in the void. It leaves marks.
bossTier.laCreatureDeMira: What Mira's miners found in the tunnels. It's not quite human anymore.
bossTier.leContremaitreInfernal: Boss of the Refinery. The workers call him Hell-on-Wheels. Not to his face.
bossTier.leFantomeDesBrumes: Master of Mist Port. Nobody knows who he is. He paid good money for that uncertainty.
bossTier.leContremaitreDeForge: He built Forge Alpha with his own hands. He defends it the same way.
bossTier.soeurValkara: She heals. She kills too, if that's what it takes to protect her sanctuary.
bossTier.aria9ProtocoleNoir: Sanctum's AI decided its objective is protection. The definition of 'threat' has evolved.
bossTier.docteurFlinch: He experiments on everything that comes in. You just came in.
bossTier.lArmuriereSkade: Every weapon she carries, she designed herself. They're flawless.
bossTier.cesarion: Emperor of Emporium Requiem. Behind the customs posts and arms dealers hides an unmatched military strategist. His imperial barrage doesn't give you time to breathe.
bossTier.raphazarus: Legendary general of the Great War. 47 years in the Lost Arc didn't break him — they honed him. He survived things no one else could have. He was waiting for someone.
bossTier.eliotis: Governor of the Tribosphere. He's always smiling. The smile vanishes when someone disturbs his party. The transformation is instant — and terrifying.
bossTier.leRoiMaxance: King of Paradoxa Eterna. Pacifist by nature, formidable by necessity. His planet's toxins show no mercy.
bossTier.samyScotty: Owner of the Scotty Golden North casino. Every credit in the sector has passed through his hands. He goes all in or nothing — and when he goes all in, the consequences are devastating.

arenaFighters.recrueDesArenes: First fight, first blood. He's barely trembling.
arenaFighters.gladiateurLocal: He fights to feed his family. Motivated.
arenaFighters.duellisteExperimente: Twenty wins on the board. He reads you like a book.
arenaFighters.sniperDeLArene: A ranged weapon in a closed cage. Bad news for you.
arenaFighters.berserkerDope: Illegal stimulants. He no longer feels anything.
arenaFighters.executeurMasque: Nobody knows his face. Only his opponents see it.
arenaFighters.chasseurDeChampions: He collects the skulls of champions. You've arrived right on time.
arenaFighters.finalisteImplacable: Finalist in three tournaments. He's never lost the last round.
arenaFighters.leChampionDesArenes: Reigning champion. Undefeated for two years. The crowd adores him. He already hates you.
